matched.description: An arranger preserves the original score, then applies prioritized instrument substitutions to structured parts. Each choice updates every linked cue, range marking, seating need, and balance instruction, may trigger another replacement, and is checked against ensemble constraints before the next step.

role_correspondences.source_role: cue, range, seating, or balance marking
role_correspondences.target_role: wording, equipment, quantity, unit, or yield

worked_source_plan: Preserve the original score and represent every instrument part, linked cue, range marking, seating need, and balance instruction as structured references.
Choose the next instrument substitution by the fixed priority list and apply it globally to the part and every dependent marking.
Adjust quantities or balance proportions with exact rational scaling, and follow any substitution that triggers a further replacement.
After each substitution, check ensemble availability and range rules before permitting the next rewrite.
Continue until no required replacement remains, yielding a consistent arrangement while leaving the original score unchanged.

Validate the entire occurrence sheet for ordering and event legality, accumulating every invalid entry.
Derive public boards, crew sheets, incident summaries, and action lists from the same validated timetable and occurrence record.
Produce plan-versus-actual reports keyed by original train number so reordered or rerouted trains remain traceable.

matched.description: The kitchen maintains the authoritative order slate, the plating station constructs what a guest sees, and a server interprets guest requests into changes and returns the resulting presentation. Nonsensical requests produce an explanation without altering accepted orders; order-taking and table delivery can be replaced during drills, and plate descriptions are deterministic.
worked_source_plan: Keep accepted guest choices in the authoritative kitchen order slate, separate from both plating and request interpretation.
Have the server translate each guest request into a proposed slate change rather than letting the request edit the slate directly.
For a valid request, commit the change and ask the plating station to construct the resulting presented plate and explanation.
For a nonsensical request, return an explanation and presentation while leaving all accepted orders unchanged.
Allow order-taking and table-delivery channels to be replaced during drills, and generate identical plate descriptions from identical slate data.

irrelevant_worked.description: A survey office keeps one marked master map. Before any copy is drawn, a clearance clerk removes restricted marks and now-empty legend groups; the remaining cross-references are renumbered in first-seen order, checked, and handed to several reproduction shops.
worked_source_plan: Keep the marked master map as the sole authoritative map and mark each feature and legend group with its clearance rule.
For a requested copy, have the clearance clerk remove restricted marks, then suppress every legend group left empty.
Walk the surviving map in fixed first-seen order and assign copy-local numbers in the cross-reference ledger.
Run the pre-copy checker to reject any surviving mark with a missing or inconsistent cross-reference.
Give the same checked, pruned, numbered map specification to each reproduction shop so every shop produces the same copy.

role_correspondences.target_role: nested group or section containing items
item contribution to aggregate word count
valid parent position in the workspace containment tree

relation_correspondences.source_relation: The desk accepts either a box or a crate through one handling procedure.
relation_correspondences.target_relation: Clients traverse and operate on leaf and composite items through a uniform contract.

relation_correspondences.source_relation: A crate's shipment weight includes the contributions of its contained boxes.
relation_correspondences.target_relation: Workspace summaries recursively aggregate child word counts and markers.

relation_correspondences.source_relation: A container may be relocated only into a location that can legally hold it.
relation_correspondences.target_relation: Moves validate containment and reject cycle/invalid-parent moves without mutation.

worked_source_plan: Represent both a single box and a crate behind the same handling interface.
Let a box report its own label and weight while a crate recursively combines the reports of its contents.
Traverse crate contents in a stable stored order so manifests are deterministic.
Before relocating a container, validate that the destination can contain it and is not inside the container being moved.
Only after all checks pass, remove the container from its old parent and attach it to the new parent atomically.

irrelevant_worked.description: A parcel meeting a standard handoff contract can pass through any sequence of independent finishing stations: a title card, concealment sleeve, customs notice, or tracking stamp. Each station encloses the result it receives; repeated visits have fixed rules, and the contents are never altered, including parcels supplied by outside packers.
worked_source_plan: Accept any parcel satisfying the standard handoff contract, including one supplied by an outside packer, and preserve its contents unchanged.
Choose any sequence of title-card, concealment-sleeve, customs-notice, and tracking-stamp stations as independent optional capabilities.
At each station, enclose the complete result received from the previous station, making the chosen order observable.
When a station repeats, apply its documented duplicate rule rather than silently adding an uncontrolled second mark.
Return a parcel that still satisfies the handoff contract so further stations can wrap it without knowledge of its core packer.
